summary: Phase-2 Monthly Expense/Trial Balance importer — full backend coverage. Added /app/backend/tests/test_historical_monthly_import.py (12 cases) covering all 8 review-request scenarios: (1) happy-path import of /tmp/hsr_mar26.xlsx → success=true, center=PB-HSR, month=2026-03, TB heads=37, total_expenses=₹14,62,630, total_sales=₹12,47,314, expense rows=93, daily_sales.days=31; (2) filename auto-detect — renamed copy 'EXPENCE SHEET -HSR- MARCH. 2026.xlsx' resolves to PB-HSR/2026-03, file without center keyword returns 400, center_override rescues it; (3) idempotency — two consecutive imports leave expenses count unchanged and historical_trial_balance has exactly ONE doc per {center,month}; (4) live-data protection — seeded a non-monthly_import row for 2026-03-15, re-import does NOT overwrite it, skipped_live_days counter ≥1; (5) /monthly-summary returns PB-HSR with months_count≥1, earliest≤2026-03≤latest, totals >₹10L; (6) RBAC — franchise token (8888888888) gets 403 on both /import-monthly-file and /clear-monthly; (7) downstream visibility — /api/center-accounts/wc-table for PB-HSR shows a 2026-03 row with expenses ≥₹9L, /api/mis/overview for 2026-03-01..2026-03-31 PB-HSR includes total_expenses ≥₹9L; (8) /clear-monthly with {center:PB-HSR, month:2026-03} deletes monthly_import expense rows and the TB doc but PRESERVES a manually-seeded live expense row. All 12 pass. Regression: 43/43 prior historical tests (test_historical_import 10 + test_historical_loans_import 10 + test_wc_target_expenses 7 + test_wc_and_attendance_lock 10 + test_mis_wc_parity 6) all green. Cleanup teardown wipes monthly_import + historical_trial_balance per main-agent instruction.

minor.issue: Per-row inserts in a Python loop (db.expenses.insert_one × 93 + db.daily_sales.update_one × 31) — fine for one center/month, but at 240 file batch-import scale (~22k inserts) will be slow. Consider insert_many for expenses and a bulk_write for daily_sales.

_parse_trial_balance_sheet (L587) uses 'first numeric cell as amount' heuristic — works for HSR's layout but is fragile against TB sheets that put a code/serial number in the first numeric column. Recommend anchoring to a column header (AMOUNT/CR/DR) once another center's TB layout is sampled.

_find_month_sheet only matches sheets whose tokens contain a 3-letter month prefix + the year; sheets named 'MARCH' (no year) won't be detected. The HSR file has 'MARCH.26' so it's fine, but other centers may have variant naming.

Wildcard wipe (no center, no month) deletes ALL monthly_import rows + ALL historical_trial_balance — this is intentional but lacks a confirm flag. A 'confirm: true' guard would prevent fat-finger wipes.

action_items: (Optional) Switch per-row inserts to bulk_write/insert_many in /import-monthly-file before bulk-importing the 240-file backlog (10 centers × 24 months).
(Optional) Harden _parse_trial_balance_sheet header detection by anchoring on AMOUNT/CR/DR column instead of first-numeric heuristic — sample another center's TB sheet to confirm.
(Optional) Extend _find_month_sheet fallback when month-sheet name has no year token (e.g. plain 'MARCH').
(Optional) Add confirm:true guard to /clear-monthly when both center & month are absent.
critical_code_review_comments: historical_import.py _detect_center_from_filename (L58) correctly tokenises on non-alphanumerics — prevents 'HSR' from matching unrelated words (verified by NO_CENTER_XLSX test).
historical_import.py /import-monthly-file (L767-893) correctly delete-then-insert monthly_import expenses (L838-841) — clean re-import without orphan rows. Verified by test_05.

historical_import.py daily_sales upsert (L863-888) deletes prior monthly_import docs, then existence-checks each day before upsert. The skipped_live_days counter is correctly populated (verified test_06).
historical_import.py /clear-monthly (L921-954) source-regex filter on monthly_import: protects live rows. Verified test_12.

historical_import.py /import-monthly-file does NOT call total_expenses_sum from daily expense rows — uses TB rollup only. WC-table downstream test (test_10) confirms expenses surface via existing /center-accounts aggregation on db.expenses. Good separation.
